question: The five-day long Ganga Mahotsav is celebrated in which city of Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganga Mahotsav** is an annual festival celebrated** in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh**, to **showcase the cultural heritage of the city** and **promote tourism.**
 
• The festival is held for** five days** and features various** cultural events** like **classical music** and **dance performances, boat races,** and a **Grand Aarti **ceremony on the **banks of the river Ganga.**
 
• The festival also includes a food festival where visitors can sample local delicacies and a crafts fair where artisans display their traditional crafts.
 
• **Varanasi is a city known for its religious and cultural significance** and is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world. It is also considered a spiritual hub in India and attracts millions of tourists every year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The main** cities of Uttar Pradesh** that are situated **along the Ganga River** are **Varanasi, Prayagraj, Kanpur.**
 
• Uttar Pradesh is a state in northern India, with **Lucknow as its capita**l. Lucknow is known for its **rich history and culture**.
 
• **Noida** is a city in the **National Capital Region (NCR) of India** and is known for its **industrial and commercial development**. 
 
• **Kanpur** is a city in Uttar Pradesh known for its** leather and textile industries.**
